generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy an existing parent primary-key value; with probability ~0.01 emit NULL when the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.bigint_fk: Copy an existing parent primary-key value; with probability ~0.01 emit NULL when the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short_code: Uppercase alphanumeric strings of length 2-4 drawn from a pool of ~500 distinct codes; allow near-variants (case changes, one-character edits) for LIKE/equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Title-case words of length 3-40; allow near-variants (truncation, case change) for LIKE literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_country: Country names from a pool of ~240 values; allow case variants (e.g. 'China'/'china') and near-variants for LIKE literals.
generic_sampling_rules.real_coordinate: Uniform real in [-180, 180] for longitude-like columns and [-90, 90] for latitude-like columns; 6 decimal places.
generic_sampling_rules.bigint_elevation: Integer in [-1500, 9000] with a long right tail; allow ties at the maximum for LIMIT(1) queries.
generic_sampling_rules.flag_y_n: Value in ('Y','N'); allow lowercase 'y' as a near-variant.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_text: With probability equal to the column's null_rate emit NULL; otherwise a fresh value from the column's domain.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: 0.3 of text values are fresh; 0.7 are drawn from the existing pool to create duplicates and ties.

generation_specification.uncertainty: The exact IATA/ICAO code pools are not fully known; near-variants are generated generically. The null_rate for routes.alid is 0.007, so NULL rows are rare but present. The formula routes.dst_ap = airports.iata holds only when the airport has an IATA code; some airports may have empty iata, so the condition is stated.

issues.evidence: Execution feedback shows several nullable columns with 'generated rows: NULL 0 / n' (airlines.active, callsign, country, iata, name; airports.city, country, elevation, iata, icao, x, y; routes.airline, dst_ap, src_ap). The interface NULL rule asks for at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance. The program only plants NULLs for spec.NULL_TARGETS (airlines.icao, routes.alid/dst_apid/src_apid/codeshare) and for FK columns via FK_NULL_P; other nullable columns are filled by samplers that drop None (ColumnSampler.__init__ filters None) and never emit NULL.
issues.requested_revision: Note for the engineer (non-blocking per instruction 7): extend _plant_targets / samplers so every nullable column receives at least one NULL row per instance with a share approximating the compact null_rate, while keeping NOT NULL/PK columns NULL-free. This is a completeness improvement, not a correctness blocker.

issues.evidence: Specification's semantic_rules_and_formulas state routes.dst_ap = airports.iata VIA routes.dst_apid (and src_ap, airline). The program implements this via _apply_dependencies/_lookup, but the lookup returns None when the parent airport has an empty/NULL iata, and the spec's own 'uncertainty' notes this. Execution shows routes.dst_ap/src_ap/airline have NULL 0 / 8012, so the formula holds for all generated rows in practice; the condition is correctly stated. No contradiction found, but the rule is only conditionally supported.
issues.requested_revision: No change required; the conditional formulation is consistent with the data. Optionally document that empty iata parents yield NULL copied codes.
